Step 2 `bash <plugin>/hooks/install-git-hooks.sh` with Y as working folder: allowed at protected_branch_guard.py:599-601 (`bash` names no target). Write/Edit name it through file_path; a shell redirect or mkdir/touch names it literally. placement() walks up from the nearest existing folder to <Y>, whose .git is a directory, so the target is Y's main checkout and Judge.verdict returns 'this is the main checkout' (protected_branch_guard.py:289-290); the deny is built at :696 with the hint 'write inside this session's worktree'.
